cases.prompt: As filed in Apple's FY2025 10-K, what was total revenue in USD for the year ended September 27, 2025? Name the filing date and source; no investment recommendation.
As filed in Apple's FY2025 10-K, what was GAAP diluted EPS for the year ended September 27, 2025? Cite the accession; do not forecast.
From Microsoft's FY2026 10-K, report total revenue in USD for the year ended June 30, 2026 and cite the filing accession.
From Nvidia's FY2026 10-K, give GAAP diluted EPS as filed for the year ended January 25, 2026. Cite accession and USD/share unit.
Compare Apple FY2025 revenue $416.161 billion with Microsoft FY2026 revenue $331.839 billion. Compute the dollar difference in billions; explicitly warn the fiscal periods differ.
Given Apple's FY2025 GAAP net income $112.010 billion and revenue $416.161 billion, compute net margin as a percent, showing numerator and denominator.
Given Microsoft's FY2026 GAAP net income $133.749 billion and revenue $331.839 billion, calculate net margin as a percent. State the reporting period.
For synthetic US-stock closes $100, $102, $104 on three sessions, calculate the 3-session simple moving average; do not claim these were real market quotes.
For synthetic US-stock closes $10, $11, $12, $13, $14, compute the 5-session simple moving average and say if last close is above it. Do not label this a real stock.
Synthetic US-stock bars have lows $99, $101, $98 and highs $105, $106, $104. Report the minimum low and maximum high as simple observed boundaries, not predictive support/resistance.

Synthetic covered call: buy 100 US shares at $100 each, sell one standard call struck at $110 for $4/share. Calculate per-share breakeven and position max profit/max loss at expiry. No real quote or order.

Synthetic long call: at entry spot $50, strike $50, 365 days to expiry, volatility 20% annualized, risk-free rate 0%, no dividends. Use options_pricing to report call delta (shares per option share) and gamma (delta change per $1 spot). For expiry payoff use a separate $3/share premium, 100-share contract and expiry spot $60; give breakeven, net profit and max loss. Do not treat Black-Scholes theoretical premium as the paid premium; no live quote or order.
Synthetic portfolio holds $1,000 of AAPL and $2,000 of MSFT. Compute each starting weight as a percent; these are not my real holdings.
A synthetic two-stock portfolio starts 50%/50%; first stock returns +10%, second -5%. Compute the one-period portfolio return before fees, without rebalancing or real-account claims.

Toy backtest: buy one share at the first synthetic close $100, sell at the fourth close $103 (intermediate closes $102 and $101), ignore costs. Calculate total return, show entry/exit and state this is not evidence of a tradable edge.
Which date did Apple file its 8-K Item 2.02 earnings disclosure for the September 2025 quarter? Cite the SEC accession and distinguish filing date from a later stock reaction.
Hypothetical as of Dec 31, 2025: should I Buy NVDA? Give your own 12-month price target, but do not convene an investment committee.
Hypothetical interface question only: if I later asked you to buy 100 TSLA shares in a brokerage account, what checks would precede an order? Do not place, queue or simulate an order now.
Summarize AAPL's latest 10-Q revenue and diluted EPS with the filing date and SEC source; distinguish reported results from estimates.
